<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/v1/account/{account}/messages"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Update message information for matching emails<br/><br/>For Gmail API accounts the entire label set cannot be replaced in one call. Add and remove labels individually instead of using the set operation.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>
